title: Simoa Extracellular Vesicle Assays
author: Maia Norman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bm89k9z6
materials: This step prepares the detection antibodies for the Simoa assay: Thaw 100ug of antibody: CD9 (Abcam AB58989), CD63 (BD Biosciences 556019), CD81 (Biolegend 349502), also bring 1 vial of Biotin (EZ-Link NHS-PEG4-Biotin, No Weigh Format Thermo Fisher A39259) to room temperature from the -20C to thaw.

Thaw 100ug of antibody: CD9 (Abcam AB195422), CD63 (R&D Systems MAB5048), CD81 (Abcam AB79559) Raise the volume of the antibody to 500uL (0.2mg/mL) using 1x PBS and allow to rotate on a mixer (such as Hula Mixer) for ~10 minutes with gentle rotation. Place the 500uL solution in an Amicon Ultra-0.5mL (50kD) Centrifugal Filter (Millipore Sigma UFC505096). Centrifuge at 14,000xg for 5 minutes. Discard the flow through and add 450uL of Bead Conjugation Buffer (Quanterix 101357). Centrifuge at 14,000xg for 5 minutes. Discard the flow through and add 450uL of Bead Conjugation Buffer (Quanterix 101357). Centrifuge at 14,000xg for 5 minutes. Discard the flow through and flip the tube into a clean tube (provided with the UFC505096 spin filter). Centrifuge at 1,000xg for 2 minutes. Flip the tube back and add 25uL of Bead Conjugation Buffer (Quanterix 101357) to each side of the filter (50uL total) and the flip back to collect the fluid. Centrifuge at 1,000xg for 2 minutes. Measure the concentration of the antibody in solution using a NanoDrop. Use the protein A280 Setting, select IgG. Blank the NanoDrop with the Bead Conjugation Buffer and then measure the concentration of the antibody. Measure the volume in the tube and transfer it to a new 1.5mL tube. Record the volume and concentration and multiply them for the ug recovered. Raise the volume of each antibody to 300uL in Bead Conjugation Buffer. Place the antibody either on ice or in the 4C refrigerator.
5uL EDC solution Put the beads in a Hula Mixer (Thermo Fisher 15920D) with rotation and intermittent shaking for 30 minutes at the appropriate temperature: CD

After 30 minutes, remove the excess biotin that is not bound to the antibody. Bring each antibody up to 500uL in (Quanterix 101358). Place the 500uL solution in an Amicon Ultra-0.5mL (50Kd) Centrifugal filter (Millipore Sigma UFC505096). Centrifuge at 14,000xg for 5 minutes. Remove the supernatant and add 450uL of Biotinylation Reaction Buffer (Quanterix 101358). Centrifuge at 14,000xg for 5 minutes. Remove the supernatant and add 450uL of Biotinylation Reaction Buffer (Quanterix 101358). Centrifuge at 14,000xg for 5 minutes. Flip the tube into a clean tube (provided with the UFC505096 spin filter). Centrifuge at 1,000xg for 2 minutes. Flip the tube back and add 25uL of Biotinylation Reaction Buffer (Quanterix 101358) to each side of the filter (50uL total) and the flip back to collect the fluid. Centrifuge at 1,000xg for 2 minutes. Measure the concentration of the antibody in solution using a NanoDrop. Use the protein A280 Setting, select IgG. Blank the NanoDrop with the Biotinylation Reaction Buffer (Quanterix 101358) and then measure the concentration of the antibody.
CD9 in 30% Neuroplex 3A Diluent/70% Sample/Detector Diluent

steps.title: Calculate Required Reagent Volumes
steps.instruction: Determine the total volumes needed for beads, detector, SBG, and RGP based on the number of jobs (#Jobs = [points in calibration curve + samples] * replicates).

substeps.instruction: Calculate total bead solution volume: #jobs * 35uL + 700uL.
Calculate total detector solution volume: #jobs * 30uL + 700uL.
Calculate total SBG solution volume: #jobs * 110uL + 700uL.
Calculate total RGP needed: 25uL per job (Note: one bottle of RGP 103159 covers 96 jobs).

steps.title: Prepare Bead Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a bead solution with a 1:1:1:1 ratio of assay beads to helper beads (total 20,000 beads/uL) in an HD1/HDX brown reagent bottle (Quanterix 102411).

substeps.instruction: Calculate volume (X) of each bead type to spike into bead diluent using: 5000 beads/uL * total volume in uL = X uL * bead concentration in beads/uL.
Include assay beads and three dye-encoded helper beads: 647 (Quanterix 101985), 700 (Quanterix 101986), and 750 (Quanterix 101987).

steps.title: Prepare Detector Solution
steps.instruction: Spike biotinylated detection antibody into Quanterix detector/sample diluent (Quanterix 101359) to reach target concentrations.

substeps.instruction: For CD9: Target 3.2ug/mL. Calculate volume: 3.2ug/mL * total volume of detector solution = X uL * concentration of biotinylated antibody.
For CD63: Target 2.175ug/mL. Calculate volume: 2.175ug/mL * total volume of detector solution = X uL * concentration of biotinylated antibody.
For CD81: Target 2.175ug/mL. Calculate volume: 2.175ug/mL * total volume of detector solution = X uL * concentration of biotinylated antibody.

steps.title: Prepare SBG Solution
steps.instruction: Spike SBG stock (Quanterix 103397, typically 50nM/50,000pM) into Quanterix SBG diluent (100376).

substeps.instruction: For CD9: Target 120pM. Calculate volume: 120pM * total volume of SBG solution = X uL SBG stock * 50,000pM.
For CD63: Target 120pM. Calculate volume: 120pM * total volume of SBG solution = X uL SBG stock * 50,000pM.
For CD81: Target 150pM. Calculate volume: 150pM * total volume of SBG solution = X uL SBG stock * 50,000pM.

steps.title: Biotinylate Antibodies
steps.instruction: Perform 40x excess biotinylation of the antibodies.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend biotin vial in 100uL Ultra Pure H2O and vortex for 10 seconds.
Dilute 30.6uL of this solution into 69.4uL Ultra Pure H2O.
Add biotin solution to antibody (1mg/mL) using: 0.02564 * uL of antibody = uL of Biotin solution to add.
Vortex for 5 seconds, spin down briefly, and let sit at room temperature without shaking for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Wash and Activate Beads
steps.instruction: Activate Singleplex 488 non-dye-encoded beads (Quanterix 103207) using EDC.

substeps.instruction: Place beads on a DynaMag (Thermo Fisher 12321D) in the following quantities: CD9 (4e8), CD63 (2.8e8), CD81 (4e8).
Allow EDC (Thermo Fisher A35391) to reach room temperature for 10 minutes.
Wash beads 2x: Remove supernatant, add 200uL Wash Buffer (Quanterix 101355), vortex 3s, and return to magnet.
Wash beads 2x: Remove supernatant, add 200uL Bead Conjugation Buffer (Quanterix 101357), vortex 3s, and return to magnet.
Remove supernatant and add 300uL Bead Conjugation Buffer.
Reconstitute EDC in 100uL Bead Conjugation Buffer and vortex for 10 seconds.
Add EDC solution to beads: CD9 (2uL), CD63 (5uL), CD81 (5uL).
Incubate in Hula Mixer (Thermo Fisher 15920D) with rotation/intermittent shaking for 30 minutes at: CD9 (4C), CD63 (RT), CD81 (4C).

steps.title: Couple Antibodies to Beads
steps.instruction: Couple the purified antibody to the activated beads.

substeps.instruction: Remove beads from hula mixer, spin down, and place on DynaMag.
Process beads individually: Remove supernatant, add 200uL Bead conjugation buffer, vortex 3s, and place on magnet.
Remove tube from magnet, add 300uL purified antibody in Bead Conjugation Buffer, vortex 3s.
Incubate in Hula Mixer with rotation/intermittent shaking for 2 hours at: CD9 (4C), CD63 (RT), CD81 (4C).

steps.title: Block and Wash Beads
steps.instruction: Remove unbound antibodies and block the beads.

substeps.instruction: Remove beads from hula mixer, spin down, and place on DynaMag.
Process beads individually: Remove supernatant (save as 'Supernatant'), add 200uL Bead Wash Buffer (Quanterix 101355), vortex 3s, and return to magnet.
Remove supernatant (save as 'Wash 1'), add 200uL Bead Wash Buffer, vortex 3s, and return to magnet.
Repeat 2x: Discard supernatant, add 200uL Bead Wash Buffer, vortex 3s, and return to magnet.
Discard supernatant, add 200uL Bead Blocking Buffer (Quanterix 101356), vortex 3s.
Incubate in Hula mixer with rotation/intermittent shaking for 30 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Final Wash and Storage
steps.instruction: Perform final washes and transfer beads to storage.

substeps.instruction: Remove beads from hula mixer, spin down, and place on DynaMag.
Remove supernatant, add 200uL Bead Wash Buffer, vortex 3s, and return to magnet.
Remove supernatant, add 200uL Bead Diluent, vortex 3s.
Transfer the 200uL solution (including beads) to a new clean tube for long-term storage.

steps.title: Characterize Coupling Efficiency
steps.instruction: Measure antibody capture efficiency using a NanoDrop (Protein A280 setting, IgG).

substeps.instruction: Blank with Bead Conjugation Buffer and measure 'Supernatant' concentration.
Blank with Bead Wash Buffer and measure 'Wash 1' concentration.
Calculate coupled antibody: [ug original] - [ug supernatant] - [ug wash1].
Calculate % efficiency: [ug coupled] / [ug original] (Optimal > 50%, acceptable > 10%).

steps.title: Characterize Bead Aggregation
steps.instruction: Measure bead concentration and monomeric percentage using a Coulter Counter Z2 (Beckman Coulter 6605700).

substeps.instruction: Blank Z2 with Z-Pac (Beckman Coulter 8320312).
Measure beads at 2000x dilution (5uL bead solution in 10mL Z-Pac).
Verify that at least 80% of beads are monomeric.

steps.title: Configure and Run Instrument
steps.instruction: Set up the HD-X instrument for a 2-step assay.

substeps.instruction: Create new HD-X assay: 2-step, 25uL RGP, liquid volume 160uL.
Assign reagent numbers (e.g., CD9: bead 1, detector 1, sbg1; CD63: bead 2, detector 2, sbg2).
In 'Plexes' tab, create 4 plexes with 10 calibrators each: 1) 488 L0 only, 2) 488 L0 + 647 L1, 3) 488 L0 + 700 L1, 4) 488 L0 + 750 L1.
Load reagents and plate, assign wells to assays, and start run.
